title: Fairytale Clipart Set - Kids Graphics - Princess, Prince, Castle, Sorcerer, Frog, Dragon, & Unicorn
author: daphnepopuliers
description:
///// THIS SET CONTAINS
* 24 digital clipart images in .PNG file
* princess, prince, castle, dragon, frog, unicorn, circle border, banner & text images
* images all have transparent backgrounds
* images are all high resolution (300 dpi/ppi)
* size of images is at least 2000 pixels at the largest side
* great for digital scrapbooking, card making, photo decoration or to give your blog or website a new look!
///// USING & EDITING YOUR FILES
Please keep in mind that for editing clipart and other digital images you need to use image editing software! Make sure you have this kind of software and you know how to work with it! Thanks!
